description: An attacker could send abnormally large or malformed voice input streams through the API Gateway, potentially overwhelming the system's processing capacity or causing the Lambda functions to crash.
An attacker could exploit vulnerabilities in the Lambda functions to gain unauthorized access to sensitive data and AWS services.
An attacker could compromise user accounts through credential brute-forcing, weak password policies, or authentication bypass attempts.
Improper configuration of cross-account access for AI/ML services could lead to unauthorized data access or resource manipulation.
An attacker could attempt to manipulate or replace Kinesis streams to intercept or modify voice processing data.
